name: PitchBook
description: PitchBook provides private market data including information on deals, investors, funds, companies, and people.
primary_blocker: Requires a standalone enterprise contract and account manager provisioning for API access.

evidence.claim: The API is a separate offering from the PitchBook platform that requires a standalone contract agreement.
PitchBook offers a RESTful JSON API covering core entity types, but it is an enterprise add-on requiring a separate contract.
Authentication uses an authorization header with the value 'PB-Token {API_KEY}'.

notes: The API is an enterprise add-on product (Direct Data) requiring a separate contract and manual provisioning of credentials via an account manager.
